caption: The drawing depicts a round wooden bucket with a lid, viewed at an angle. The bucket is primarily painted in a blue tone, with two horizontal brown bands encircling it—one near the top and one near the bottom. The panels making up the body of the bucket are vertically aligned and separated by thin lines, suggesting individual wooden slats. The lid fits snugly on top and has a handle that runs across its center, also painted blue. On either side of the bucket, two vertical projections rise above the lid, each with a large circular hole near the top. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present in the image. Shadows and highlights suggest the light source is coming from the upper right, creating a sense of depth and dimension on the bucket and lid.
title: Covered Tub
